cohort: The study included 328 patients with preeclampsia (PE), intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR), or both, and 129 controls, all of whom gave birth within 14 days from inclusion.
finding: A significant positive correlation was found between PlGF and placental weight, which increased with disease severity, while an inverse correlation was observed between the sFlt-1/PlGF-ratio and placental weight in preeclampsia-associated pregnancy disorders.
